home.heroSubtitle: Describe the trip you want. JourneyMesh picks the right specialists, checks the numbers and hands you a plan you can change.
home.step1Body: Free text, structured fields, or both. Nothing is sent to a model before the guardrails clear it.
home.step2Body: A weather question runs one agent. A full journey runs five. Nothing runs that is not needed.
home.step3Title: You review before anything is final
home.step3Body: Approve the draft, or say what to change. Only the affected parts are planned again.

about.title: JourneyMesh
about.intro: JourneyMesh is an AI-powered travel planning platform that coordinates specialised agents for flights, accommodation, weather, budgeting, and itinerary generation. It combines agentic orchestration with human review to create practical, personalised travel plans.
about.languagesBody: The interface and the generated journey are available in English, Bengali and Hindi. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
about.subtitle: AI-Powered Multi-Agent Travel Planning
about.howItWorksBody: Every request follows the same path. Nothing is treated as final until a person approves it.

request.title: User request
request.body: A trip described in ordinary language, with optional structured details.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.body: Relevance, safety and personal data are checked before anything expensive runs.

supervisor.title: Supervisor agent
supervisor.body: Decides which specialists this particular request actually needs.

agents.title: Specialised agents
agents.body: Flight, hotel, weather, budget and itinerary agents run in dependency order.

tools.title: Tools and external APIs
tools.body: Authorised calls reach travel providers through the Model Context Protocol.

draft.title: Draft itinerary
draft.body: Results are validated, scored and assembled into a reviewable plan.

review.title: Human-in-the-loop review
review.body: You approve the draft, or say what should change.

final.title: Final travel plan
final.body: The approved journey, rendered in your language.

orchestration.title: Multi-agent orchestration
orchestration.body: LangGraph coordinates specialised agents based on the user's request.

hitl.title: Human-in-the-loop
hitl.body: Users can review, revise, or approve AI-generated travel plans before finalisation.

routing.title: Intelligent agent routing
routing.body: The Supervisor Agent determines which specialised agents and tools are needed.

data.title: Travel data integration
data.body: External APIs and MCP tools provide relevant travel information.

guardrails.title: Safety guardrails
guardrails.body: Requests are validated before expensive agents or external tools execute.

stateful.title: Stateful workflows
stateful.body: LangGraph thread and checkpoint state allow interrupted workflows to continue across review and revision.

observability.title: Observability
observability.body: LangSmith provides tracing and debugging of AI workflow execution.

api.title: Production API
api.body: FastAPI exposes the backend through structured, versioned API endpoints.

about.stackBody: Everything listed here is a dependency or a committed configuration file in the repository.
about.engineeringBody: Built as an end-to-end Agentic AI engineering project: the interesting problems here are orchestration, safety, state and delivery rather than any single model call.
about.disclaimer: JourneyMesh provides AI-assisted travel recommendations. Verify prices, availability, schedules, visa requirements, and other important details before booking.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: Choose the language for the interface and for generated journeys.
settings.sessionBody: Journeys are grouped by a session id stored in this browser. Clearing it starts a fresh history.
settings.sessionCleared: Started a new history. Past journeys are no longer listed here.
